title: ONP News Object Envelope
description: Machine-checkable structural schema for the News Object envelope, derived from ONP-1000 v0.3.0 Section 5.1 (field list, closed top level per Section 4.1 rule 3 via ONP-0001), ONP-1001 Appendix A (OID/VID grammar), and ONP-1003 Section 4.2 (signature string). SCOPE: this schema checks STRUCTURE ONLY — it is the machine form of ONP-1000 Section 6.1's structural check. It does not and cannot verify VID integrity, signature validity, or Trust Anchor resolution (ONP-1001/1003/0004); passing this schema is necessary, never sufficient, for Core authentication. The specification text remains authoritative wherever this schema and the text disagree.

oid.description: ONP-1001 Section 4.1 / Appendix A: onp:oid:<domain>:<local-id>, where local-id is 1*128(a-z 0-9 '-') or a UUIDv4.

publisher.description: ONP-1000 Section 5.1: the Publisher Reference — the Core-owned pointer used for Trust Anchor resolution (ONP-0004).

domain.description: Publisher domain; ONP-1001 Section 6.1 additionally requires it to be byte-identical to the OID's domain segment (a cross-field check outside JSON Schema's reach — enforced by validateCore, not here).

signed_at.description: ONP-1000 v0.2.0: the Claimed Signing Time — ISO 8601 UTC ('Z' suffix required), consumed by ONP-0004 key-rotation window checks and ONP-1003.

signature.description: ONP-1003 Section 4.2: onp:sig:<algorithm-id>:<base64url sig bytes>. Algorithm-id form per ONP-0005 Appendix A (lowercase, hyphenated).

content_type.description: ONP-1000 Section 4.4 rule 2: onp:companion:<name>, naming the Companion that owns content's schema.

content.description: ONP-1000 Section 4.4 rule 1: opaque to Core validation; its internal schema is owned entirely by the Companion named in content_type and is deliberately unconstrained here.

lifecycle_state.description: ONP-0006, wire format finalized in ONP-1000 Section 5.1. Absent means 'published' (absence-has-meaning; a schema default is intentionally NOT declared so validators never inject the value into signed bytes).

supersedes.description: ONP-0006: a prior VID in the same OID lineage.

republish_of_retraction.description: ONP-0006: a prior VID; only on a republish following a retraction.

onp:extensions.description: ONP-0001 Section 5.2: the reserved Extension container, keyed by reverse-DNS namespace identifiers. Each Extension's internal schema is owned by that Extension's own specification.

onp:metadata.description: ONP-1005: Core metadata container; internal structure owned by ONP-1005 and not duplicated here.

vid.description: ONP-1001 Appendix A: onp:vid:<hash-algorithm-id>:<unpadded base64url digest>.
